title: Triangle Inequality for Relative Hamming Distance
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\beta$ be a type with decidable equality, and let $f,g,h:\Omega\to\beta$. Then the relative Hamming distance between $f$ and $g$ is at most the sum of the relative Hamming distances between $h$ and $f$ and between $h$ and $g$.
